blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all current neutral, back, side, three-quarter, crouch, sit and prone renders shows the overskirt remains severely crumpled and asymmetric, with large rear-side masses and openings. Lavender strips still bridge empty space and cross folded skirt surfaces instead of following a continuous hem. Crouch and sit show thighs emerging through the skirt and stretched plate-like fabric below it; prone has projecting hip folds.

Irregular gray patches and angular surface changes remain visible across the chest and waist in front, three-quarter, side and posed renders. The images do not establish whether these are intersections, exposed surfaces or shading defects; the current visible appearance is unacceptable.
The current arms-up and arm-cross renders show sleeve tubes following the observed arm silhouettes; this does not establish numeric fit or runtime behavior.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
